item.title: Version 3.4.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • Window capture produced an empty image — the window search picked the backmost window instead of the frontmost one, which meant capturing the desktop backstop
  • Wrong resolution on secondary displays — window captures now use the scale of the display the window is actually on
  • Untitled windows were not capturable — affected Electron apps, games and some Java apps
  • Colour picker and loupe — moved off a deprecated API and fixed cursor coordinates on multi-display setups
  • Capture failures were invisible — errors now surface as a message instead of failing silently

Added

  • Interactive window picker — "Capture Window…" outlines the window under the pointer; click to capture, ESC to cancel
  • Capture Frontmost Window — the previous one-shot behaviour, still on ⌃⇧⌘5

item.title: Version 3.4.0
item.description:
Added

  • Preferences UI redesign — dark-themed, four-tab preferences window matching the Mika+ brand aesthetic
  • Shortcut configuration — inline hotkey recorder with conflict detection and restore-defaults
  • Annotation defaults — configurable default tool, stroke color, and stroke width

Fixed

  • App inaccessible after Dock close — removed activation policy switching; app stays permanently in .accessory mode

item.title: Version 3.3.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • Check for Updates — Sparkle auto-update now works; replaced placeholder SUFeedURL and SUPublicEDKey in Info.plist with real values
  • Update menu button — now visually disabled when Sparkle updater is not ready

Added

  • Initial Sparkle appcast hosted on GitHub for update checks
